chunk_text: Neuro f/u. Hx of MS on interferon beta, MRI brain shows new periventricular demyelinating lesions.

A/P: chronickidney disease stag 3, cr stable at 1.6, continue ACE inhibitor.
PMH: diabtes melitus typ 2 on metformin, A1c 7.4 last month.
BMI 37.2. Assessment: obesity class ii, counselled on diet and exercise.
Pt reports constipation for 3 days, no blood in stool. Start senna.
MRI brain: acute infarct in the left MCA territory. Stroke team consulted.
Troponin 4.2, ST elevation in V2-V4, acute infarct; cath lab activated.
ROS: denies headache, vision change or focal neurologic symptoms.
C/o right knee pain after fall, worse on stairs, mild effusion on exam.
